items.title: How much does preflight caching actually save?
items.description: A page makes 20 non-simple cross-origin requests spaced 30 seconds apart (a 9.5-minute session). Drag the server's Access-Control-Max-Age (how long the browser is allowed to cache a preflight result) and watch how many separate OPTIONS preflight round-trips actually happen.
items.compute: const requestCount = 20; const intervalSeconds = 30; let preflightCount = 0; let lastPreflightTime = -Infinity; for (let i = 0; i < requestCount; i++) { const t = i * intervalSeconds; if (t - lastPreflightTime >= params.maxAgeSeconds) { preflightCount++; lastPreflightTime = t; } } return { preflightCount };
